1→# VEX Functions Reference
     2→
     3→## Attribute Access
     4→
     5→### Built-in Attributes (read/write with @)
     6→- `@P` - Point position (vector)
     7→- `@N` - Normal vector
     8→- `@Cd` - Color (vector)
     9→- `@v` - Velocity (vector)
    10→- `@pscale` - Point scale (float)
    11→- `@id` - Particle ID (int)
    12→- `@orient` - Orientation quaternion (vector4)
    13→- `@up` - Up vector for orientation (vector)
    14→- `@rest` - Rest position for noise (vector)
    15→- `@uv` - UV coordinates (vector)
    16→- `@Alpha` - Point opacity (float)
    17→- `@width` - Curve width (float)
    18→- `@age` - Particle age in seconds (float)
    19→- `@life` - Particle life expectancy (float)
    20→
    21→### Context Variables (read-only)
    22→- `@ptnum` - Current point number
    23→- `@numpt` - Total point count
    24→- `@primnum` - Current primitive number
    25→- `@numprim` - Total primitive count
    26→- `@vtxnum` - Current vertex number
    27→- `@Frame` - Current frame number (float)
    28→- `@Time` - Current time in seconds (float)
    29→- `@TimeInc` - Time increment per frame
    30→- `@OpInput1` - Path to first input (string)
    31→
    32→### Type Prefixes
    33→```vex
    34→f@density = 1.0;        // float
    35→i@id = 42;              // integer
    36→v@velocity = {0,1,0};   // vector (3 floats)
    37→p@orient = {0,0,0,1};   // vector4 (quaternion)
    38→s@name = "piece1";      // string
    39→2@xform = ident();      // matrix2
    40→3@transform = ident();  // matrix3
    41→4@xform4 = ident();     // matrix (4x4)
    42→```
    43→
    44→## Geometry Functions
    45→
    46→### Read Attributes
    47→- `point(input, "attr", ptnum)` - Read point attribute
    48→- `prim(input, "attr", primnum)` - Read prim attribute
    49→- `vertex(input, "attr", linearidx)` - Read vertex attribute
    50→- `detail(input, "attr")` - Read detail attribute (single value for whole geo)
    51→
    52→### Write Attributes
    53→- `setpointattrib(geohandle, "attr", ptnum, value)` - Write point attribute
    54→- `setprimattrib(geohandle, "attr", primnum, value)` - Write prim attribute
    55→- `setdetailattrib(geohandle, "attr", value)` - Write detail attribute
    56→
    57→### Create/Delete Geometry
    58→- `addpoint(geohandle, position)` - Create new point, returns ptnum
    59→- `addprim(geohandle, "poly")` - Create new primitive, returns primnum
    60→- `addvertex(geohandle, primnum, ptnum)` - Add vertex to prim
    61→- `removepoint(geohandle, ptnum)` - Delete point
    62→- `removeprim(geohandle, primnum, andpoints)` - Delete prim (andpoints=1 to also delete points)
    63→
    64→### Query Geometry
    65→- `npoints(input)` - Count points on input
    66→- `nprims(input)` - Count prims on input
    67→- `nvertices(input)` - Count vertices on input
    68→- `primpoints(input, primnum)` - Get point numbers of a prim
    69→- `pointprims(input, ptnum)` - Get prim numbers connected to a point
    70→- `primintrinsic(input, "measuredarea", primnum)` - Read intrinsic attribute
    71→
    72→### Spatial Queries
    73→- `nearpoint(input, pos)` - Find nearest point (returns ptnum)
    74→- `nearpoints(input, pos, radius, maxpts)` - Find multiple nearest points
    75→- `pcfind(input, "P", pos, radius, maxpts)` - Point cloud search (fast)
    76→- `pcopen(input, "P", pos, radius, maxpts)` - Open point cloud handle
    77→- `pcfilter(handle, "attr")` - Filter point cloud attribute (smooth/average)
    78→- `pcclose(handle)` - Close point cloud handle
    79→- `intersect(input, origin, dir, pos, u, v)` - Ray-geometry intersection
    80→- `xyzdist(input, pos, primnum, primuv)` - Distance to nearest surface
    81→
    82→## Math Functions
    83→
    84→### Vector Operations
    85→- `length(v)` - Vector length (magnitude)
    86→- `length2(v)` - Squared length (faster, no sqrt)
    87→- `normalize(v)` - Unit vector
    88→- `dot(a, b)` - Dot product (alignment: 1=same, 0=perpendicular, -1=opposite)
    89→- `cross(a, b)` - Cross product (perpendicular vector)
    90→- `distance(a, b)` - Distance between points
    91→- `reflect(dir, normal)` - Reflect direction off normal
    92→- `refract(dir, normal, ior)` - Refract through surface
    93→
    94→### Interpolation
    95→- `lerp(a, b, t)` - Linear interpolation
    96→- `slerp(a, b, t)` - Spherical interpolation (for quaternions/normals)
    97→- `fit(val, omin, omax, nmin, nmax)` - Remap value range
    98→- `fit01(val, nmin, nmax)` - Remap 0-1 to new range
    99→- `efit(val, omin, omax, nmin, nmax)` - Remap with clamping
   100→- `clamp(val, min, max)` - Clamp value
   101→- `smooth(min, max, val)` - Smooth step (hermite)
   102→- `chramp("ramp", pos)` - Evaluate ramp parameter (0-1 in, float out)
   103→
   104→### Basic Math
   105→- `abs(v)` - Absolute value
   106→- `floor(v)` / `ceil(v)` / `round(v)` - Rounding
   107→- `sign(v)` - Sign (-1, 0, or 1)
   108→- `min(a, b)` / `max(a, b)` - Min/max
   109→- `pow(base, exp)` - Power
   110→- `sqrt(v)` - Square root
   111→- `log(v)` / `log10(v)` - Logarithms
   112→- `exp(v)` - e^v
   113→- `sin(a)` / `cos(a)` / `tan(a)` - Trigonometry (radians)
   114→- `asin(v)` / `acos(v)` / `atan(v)` - Inverse trig
   115→- `atan2(y, x)` - Two-argument arctangent
   116→- `radians(deg)` / `degrees(rad)` - Angle conversion
   117→
   118→## Noise Functions
   119→
   120→- `noise(pos)` - Perlin noise (0 to 1)
   121→- `snoise(pos)` - Signed Perlin noise (-1 to 1)
   122→- `onoise(pos)` - Original noise (Houdini classic)
   123→- `curlnoise(pos)` - Curl noise (divergence-free -- ideal for smoke/fluid advection)
   124→- `anoise(pos)` - Alligator noise (cellular, sharp)
   125→- `vnoise(pos, jitter)` - Voronoi noise (returns cell distances)
   126→- `flownoise(pos, flow)` - Flow noise (animated without sliding)
   127→- `xnoise(pos)` - Simplex noise (faster than Perlin, fewer artifacts)
   128→
   129→### Noise Tips
   130→- Add `@Time` or `@Frame` to position for animated noise: `noise(@P + @Time * 0.5)`
   131→- Multiply position to change frequency: `noise(@P * 5.0)` = higher frequency
   132→- Layer octaves for detail: `noise(@P) * 0.5 + noise(@P*2) * 0.25 + noise(@P*4) * 0.125`
   133→- `curlnoise` is mass-conserving -- use for velocity fields, smoke turbulence
   134→
   135→## String Functions
   136→
   137→- `sprintf(fmt, ...)` - Format string (like C printf)
   138→- `concat(a, b)` - Concatenate strings
   139→- `strlen(s)` - String length
   140→- `substr(s, start, len)` - Substring
   141→- `match(pattern, s)` - Glob pattern match (returns 1 or 0)
   142→- `re_match(pattern, s)` - Regex match
   143→- `split(s, sep)` - Split string into array
   144→- `join(sep, array)` - Join array into string
   145→- `strip(s)` - Trim whitespace
   146→- `replace(s, old, new)` - Replace substring
   147→
   148→## Channel Functions
   149→
   150→- `ch("parm")` - Read float channel (from node parameters)
   151→- `chs("parm")` - Read string channel
   152→- `chv("parm")` - Read vector channel
   153→- `chi("parm")` - Read integer channel
   154→- `chramp("ramp", pos)` - Evaluate ramp parameter
   155→- `chf("../other_node/parm")` - Read from another node (relative path)
   156→
   157→## Matrix Functions
   158→
   159→- `maketransform(order, xyz, t, r, s)` - Build transform matrix
   160→- `invert(m)` - Invert matrix
   161→- `transpose(m)` - Transpose matrix
   162→- `determinant(m)` - Matrix determinant
   163→- `identity()` - Identity matrix 4x4
   164→- `lookat(from, to, up)` - Build look-at rotation matrix
   165→- `dihedral(a, b)` - Rotation matrix from vector a to vector b
   166→- `quaternion(angle, axis)` - Create quaternion from angle-axis
   167→- `qrotate(quat, vector)` - Rotate vector by quaternion
   168→- `eulertoquaternion(r, order)` - Euler angles to quaternion
   169→
   170→## Utility
   171→
   172→- `printf("msg %g\\n", val)` - Debug print to Houdini console
   173→- `warning("msg")` - Raise node warning
   174→- `error("msg")` - Raise node error (stops cooking)
   175→- `assert(condition)` - Assert condition
   176→- `rand(@ptnum)` - Random float 0-1 per point (deterministic from seed)
   177→- `random(seed)` - Random vector from seed
   178→- `set(x, y, z)` - Create vector from components
   179→- `getcomp(v, idx)` - Get vector component by index
   180→- `setcomp(v, val, idx)` - Set vector component by index
   181→- `array(a, b, c)` - Create array
   182→
   183→## Common VEX Patterns
   184→
   185→### Scatter with Constraints
   186→```vex
   187→// Remove points below a height threshold
   188→if (@P.y < ch("min_height")) removepoint(0, @ptnum);
   189→```
   190→
   191→### Orient from Normal
   192→```vex
   193→// Set orient quaternion from N and up for copy-to-points
   194→v@up = set(0, 1, 0);
   195→p@orient = dihedral(set(0, 0, 1), @N);
   196→```
   197→
   198→### Color by Attribute
   199→```vex
   200→// Color by height with ramp
   201→float height = fit(@P.y, ch("min_y"), ch("max_y"), 0, 1);
   202→v@Cd = chramp("color_ramp", height);
   203→```
   204→
   205→### Custom Deformer
   206→```vex
   207→// Sine wave deformation
   208→float amp = ch("amplitude");
   209→float freq = ch("frequency");
   210→@P.y += sin(@P.x * freq + @Time * 2) * amp;
   211→```
   212→
   213→### Group by Expression
   214→```vex
   215→// Add to group based on condition
   216→if (@P.y > ch("threshold")) i@group_top = 1;
   217→```
   218→
   219→### Point Cloud Averaging
   220→```vex
   221→// Smooth positions using neighbors
   222→int handle = pcopen(0, "P", @P, ch("radius"), chi("maxpts"));
   223→@P = pcfilter(handle, "P");
   224→pcclose(handle);
   225→```
   226→
   227→### Random Attribute from ID
   228→```vex
   229→// Stable random value per piece (survives point reorder)
   230→f@rand_val = rand(i@id * 12345 + 67890);
   231→v@Cd = set(rand(i@id), rand(i@id+1), rand(i@id+2));
   232→```
   233→
   234→## See Also
   235→- **Joy of VEX: Nearpoints & Proximity** (`joy_of_vex_nearpoints.md`) -- tutorial examples with nearpoints, pcfind
   236→- **Joy of VEX: Point Clouds** (`joy_of_vex_pcopen.md`) -- tutorial examples with pcopen, pcfilter
   237→- **Joy of VEX: Surface Sampling** (`joy_of_vex_surface_sampling.md`) -- tutorial examples with primuv, xyzdist
   238→
